name: Trouble☆Majo Shiken ~Kaichou-sama to Tennenkko wa Majo Shimai! Nakadashi Ecchi de Maryoku Hokyuu o Otetsudai!~
original_name: とらぶる☆魔女試験～会長様と天然っ娘は魔女姉妹！中出しエッチで魔力補給をお手伝い！～
source:
Minato is a university student. One day, when he goes to the school, he sees Eriko and Sayako fighting against a monster using magic. While they pay attention to him, they are attacked and get cursed by the monster. He is forced to take the blame and told to sleep with them to relieve the curse....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
凑是一名大学生。一天，他来到学校，看见绘理子与小夜子正使用魔法和怪物战斗。两人因分神注意到他，被怪物趁机袭击并中了诅咒。凑被迫为此负责，而解除诅咒的方法，是与她们发生性关系……

[摘自ErogeShop]
